sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: Pellice's only approval for HB-620 is for the Pinerolo plant (PLT-PIN). The ASL has no approval for delivery to Beinasco (PLT-BEI), and approval is per part, receiving plant and customer.

sources.quote: A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before the first shipment.

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y, a Nordhavn program. Pellice is a new source for it, and the proposed delivery to a different plant is a further change. No written Nordhavn approval or PPAP is in the documents, and the only approval on file is the internal APR-011.
